_sources: Ports, the one param and the code: spec 005 (specs/005-first-models/spec.md).
The weights' file: pinned by spec 003's live run (specs/003-model-store/live/live.depth_pro), which spec 005's spike loaded on the owner's PC.

The memory model: spec 005's local session on an NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 (compute 6.1, 8 GB), fitted with bench:fit on the 768 and 1536 px photos and checked on the full one, beside its spike's weights and fp32 figures (allocated memory, turned from MiB into MB). A first estimate every machine corrects (learned.json), never a choice made for that card.
fp16 on any card: torch runs half precision on every card its builds support; the spike ran it on compute 6.1 only.
Licences: from the README and LICENSE of apple/ml-depth-pro at 9e65e4d, the runtime's pin.
title: Depth Pro
summary: Apple's Depth Pro: sharp metric depth and the focal length from one photo, at a fixed 1536 px. Uses a known camera's focal length when one is connected.

camera.doc: Known intrinsics: its focal length is used instead of the estimate, and it is the camera handed on.

depth.doc: Metres along the camera's axis, at the photo's size.

camera.doc: The camera the depth was made with: its own focal estimate (source estimated), or the connected one's, at the photo's size.

weights.source: specs/005-first-models/reports/2026-11-03-spike.md: on the card once loaded, 3,636 and 1,826 MiB, on a GTX 1070 (compute 6.1)

working.source: specs/005-first-models/reports/2026-11-06-ac7.md: bench:fit's peaks less the weights on a GTX 1070 (compute 6.1), on the 768 and 1536 px photos: at fp16 on the card, torch's reserve, 6,206 and 6,178 MB (4,289 MB working, the larger); at fp32 on a card, the spike's 5,161 MiB (specs/005-first-models/reports/2026-11-03-spike.md, allocated memory) until a card that holds it reports, which also covers the processor's 8,836 and 8,842 MB. A line through the two precisions; the pixels term is the steepest rise from 768 to 1536 px any setting showed (the processor's). The network runs at 1536 px whatever the photo's size

system_mb.source: specs/005-first-models/reports/2026-11-06-ac7.md: at fp16 on a GTX 1070 (compute 6.1), the process's peak, 2,657 MB on both photos, when the weights' file (fp16) is read and cast to fp16, which copies nothing. At fp32 on a card, not measured (it does not fit this one): the load holds the file and its fp32 cast at once (node.py), so the terms add the cast, the fp32 weights, and nothing at fp16

cpu.source: specs/005-first-models/reports/2026-11-03-spike.md: import, load and first inference (7, 28 and 100 s) on an Intel Core i7-4770K, 4 cores

licence.weights: Apple's sample-code licence, the code's: its README releases the weights under the same LICENSE (Hugging Face's copy of them says apple-amlr)
